system: OnCo Ask (extractive answer, lexical + concept retrieval, top 6 records)
method: For each question: MiniSearch and concept-index retrieval fused by reciprocal rank, top 6 records; the extractive answer shown on /ask/ (best sentences, two per record, one citation each) is scored for rubric coverage. No language model.
For each question: MiniSearch retrieval over the site index; rubric coverage of tldr+summary of the top entities. 1 point per rubric item met, normalised to 0-1.
